local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local speed = 16
local infiniteJump = true

-- Crear GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Full Auto Farm, Instant Catch, Auto Perfect +
scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for "Deep Fishing" uses FishyUI and opens with RightShift, driving the game's own client controllers rather than spamming remotes so the server's suspect and flag checks never see anything odd. Instant Catch pins FishSchool.CatchBandScale — the Fish Magnet multiplier — so fish sit inside the grab box the moment the window opens, going through the game's normal TryGrab path so offer prompts, catch fights, and FishHooked all fire as they would from a real client. A rarity filter spends limited hook slots rarest-first, can take whatever's left before reeling, and turns the magnet down when selective so the game's own grab doesn't scoop up junk. Auto reel trips the game's own EarlyOutPending end-run, Auto fight clicks out the tug mini-game, and Double Speed uses the server's own x1.5 group-gated accelerator, with an honest note explaining why a sub-1s catch isn't possible given the server clock on arc and return durations. Economy features cover auto sell (virtual, trip to buyer, or virtual with trip fallback), sell-by-rarity sweeps, auto-lock guards, auto-delete filters with matching mutation keys, auto bait use and purchase, best-rod buying and equipping, and affordable upgrade purchases. Enchant rolls on a timer and stops itself the moment a target lands or the server sends Denied, while Progress handles code redemption, one-press and auto claiming, Full Progression (everything on at once plus best-world travel), and teleports to unlocked worlds and live landmarks. Player tab covers reasserted walk speed and jump power, fly with WASD plus Space and Shift, noclip, infinite jump, anti-idle, and instant proximity prompts, while Performance strips lighting, particles, and materials in two tiers with an FPS cap. Misc adds rejoin and true server hop (paged until a different JobId with a free slot appears), a Cmdr console for the game's admin-gated commands, and a debug panel showing context source, magnet value, catch state, sell route, and every gate that could be blocking progress.

Deep Fishing, Fishing, DeepFishing

scripts.features: Can teleport ricks portal or smth mobile
scripts.script:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local backpack=player:WaitForChild("Backpack")

local GREEN=Color3.fromRGB(45,255,90)
local LIGHT_GREEN=Color3.fromRGB(150,255,170)
local BODY=Color3.fromRGB(150,150,145)
local DARK=Color3.fromRGB(55,57,55)

local GUN_SCALE=.45

-- Portal entry cooldown
local PORTAL_COOLDOWN=1
local portalCooldown=false

local portals={Portal1=nil,Portal2=nil}
local connections={Portal1=nil,Portal2=nil}
local selectedPortal="Portal1"
local gunConnection=nil
local gunEquipped=false

local function removePortal(name)
	if connections[name] then
		connections[name]:Disconnect()
		connections[name]=nil
	end

	if portals[name] then
		portals[name]:Destroy()
		portals[name]=nil
	end
end

local function createPortal(name,pos)
	local character=player.Character
	if not character then return end

	local camera=workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not camera then return end

	local ray=camera:ViewportPointToRay(pos.X,pos.Y)

	local params=RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}

	local hit=workspace:Raycast(
		ray.Origin,
		ray.Direction*1000,
		params
	)

	if not hit then return end

	removePortal(name)

	local position=hit.Position
	local normal=hit.Normal
	local up=Vector3.yAxis

	if math.abs(normal:Dot(up))>.95 then
		up=Vector3.xAxis
	end

	local portalCFrame=CFrame.lookAt(
		position+normal*.05,
		position+normal,
		up
	)

	local model=Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name=name
	model.Parent=workspace
	portals[name]=model

	local portal=Instance.new("Part")
	portal.Name="Portal"
	portal.Size=Vector3.new(7,10,.4)
	portal.CFrame=portalCFrame
	portal.Color=GREEN
	portal.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
	portal.Transparency=.25
	portal.Anchored=true
	portal.CanCollide=false
	portal.CanTouch=true
	portal.CanQuery=false
	portal.Parent=model

	local mesh=Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	mesh.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.Sphere
	mesh.Scale=Vector3.new(.55,1,.07)
	mesh.Parent=portal

	local inner=Instance.new("Part")
	inner.Name="PortalCore"
	inner.Size=Vector3.new(6.2,9.2,.15)
	inner.CFrame=portalCFrame*CFrame.new(0,0,-.12)
	inner.Color=LIGHT_GREEN
	inner.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
	inner.Transparency=.35
	inner.Anchored=true
	inner.CanCollide=false
	inner.CanTouch=false
	inner.CanQuery=false
	inner.Parent=model

	local innerMesh=Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	innerMesh.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.Sphere
	innerMesh.Scale=Vector3.new(.55,1,.05)
	innerMesh.Parent=inner

	local light=Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color=GREEN
	light.Brightness=8
	light.Range=18
	light.Parent=portal

	local attachment=Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent=portal

	local particles=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	particles.Color=ColorSequence.new(GREEN)
	particles.LightEmission=1
	particles.LightInfluence=0
	particles.Rate=120
	particles.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.4,1)
	particles.Speed=NumberRange.new(1,4)
	particles.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180)
	particles.Size=NumberSequence.new{
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.2),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.5,.08),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)
	}
	particles.Parent=attachment

	for i=1,4 do
		local ring=Instance.new("Part")
		ring.Name="EnergyRing"
		ring.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		ring.Size=Vector3.new(.08,6+i*.55,6+i*.55)

		ring.CFrame=
			portalCFrame*
			CFrame.Angles(
				math.rad(90),
				0,
				math.rad(i*45)
			)

		ring.Color=GREEN
		ring.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
		ring.Transparency=.3
		ring.Anchored=true
		ring.CanCollide=false
		ring.CanTouch=false
		ring.CanQuery=false
		ring.Parent=model
	end

	local start=os.clock()

	connections[name]=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not model.Parent then return end

		local elapsed=os.clock()-start
		local pulse=1+math.sin(elapsed*5)*.06

		portal.Size=Vector3.new(7,10,.4)*pulse

		local index=0

		for _,object in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
			if object.Name=="EnergyRing" then
				index+=1

				object.CFrame=
					portal.CFrame*
					CFrame.Angles(
						math.rad(90),
						elapsed*(index*.8),
						math.rad(index*45)
					)
			end
		end
	end)

	portal.Touched:Connect(function(hitPart)

		-- 1 second global portal cooldown
		if portalCooldown then return end

		if not hitPart:IsDescendantOf(character) then return end

		local destination=
			name=="Portal1"
			and "Portal2"
			or "Portal1"

		local destinationModel=portals[destination]
		if not destinationModel then return end

		local destinationPortal=
			destinationModel:FindFirstChild("Portal")

		if not destinationPortal then return end

		local root=
			character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if not root then return end

		portalCooldown=true

		-- Small delay before teleport
		task.wait(.15)

		-- Teleport through the destination portal
		root.CFrame=
			destinationPortal.CFrame*
			CFrame.new(0,0,-4)

		-- Keep the player upright
		local position=root.Position

		root.CFrame=CFrame.new(position)*CFrame.Angles(
			0,
			math.rad(root.Orientation.Y),
			0
		)

		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero

		-- 1 second cooldown
		task.wait(PORTAL_COOLDOWN)

		portalCooldown=false
	end)

	-- Infinite portal lifetime
end

local function makePart(parent,name,size,color,material,cframe)
	local part=Instance.new("Part")

	part.Name=name
	part.Size=size
	part.Color=color
	part.Material=material
	part.CFrame=cframe
	part.CanCollide=false
	part.CanTouch=false
	part.CanQuery=false
	part.Massless=true
	part.CastShadow=false
	part.Parent=parent

	return part
end

scripts.title: ESP With Health Bar
scripts.features:
Most Of My Scripts Are Open Source!

Feel Free To Learn Off It Or Take It 

MAKE SURE TO FOLLOW!!!
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Configuration
local ESPEnabled = true
local ESPColor = Color3.new(1, 0, 0) -- Red for boxes
local ESPThickness = 1

local activeDrawings = {}

-- Helper function to create a player's visual elements (Box + Health Bar)
local function createVisuals()
    local visuals = {}
    
    -- Main ESP Box
    visuals.Box = Drawing.new("Square")
    visuals.Box.Visible = false
    visuals.Box.Color = ESPColor
    visuals.Box.Thickness = ESPThickness
    visuals.Box.Filled = false
    
    -- Health Bar Background (Outline)
    visuals.HealthBarBg = Drawing.new("Line")
    visuals.HealthBarBg.Visible = false
    visuals.HealthBarBg.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    visuals.HealthBarBg.Thickness = 3
    
    -- Health Bar Fill (Dynamic)
    visuals.HealthBar = Drawing.new("Line")
    visuals.HealthBar.Visible = false
    visuals.HealthBar.Color = Color3.new(0, 1, 0) -- Green
    visuals.HealthBar.Thickness = 1
    
    return visuals
end

-- Helper function to clean up a player's drawings
local function removeVisuals(player)
    if activeDrawings[player] then
        activeDrawings[player].Box:Remove()
        activeDrawings[player].HealthBarBg:Remove()
        activeDrawings[player].HealthBar:Remove()
        activeDrawings[player] = nil
    end
end

-- Initialize tracking for existing players
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if player ~= LocalPlayer then
        activeDrawings[player] = createVisuals()
    end
end

-- Handle new players joining
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    if player ~= LocalPlayer then
        activeDrawings[player] = createVisuals()
    end
end)

-- Handle players leaving (cleanup memory)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    removeVisuals(player)
end)

-- Centralized render loop (runs every frame)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not ESPEnabled then
        for _, visuals in pairs(activeDrawings) do
            visuals.Box.Visible = false
            visuals.HealthBarBg.Visible = false
            visuals.HealthBar.Visible = false
        end
        return
    end

    for player, visuals in pairs(activeDrawings) do
        local character = player.Character
        local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        
        -- Verify character validity and life state
        if character and rootPart and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
            -- Project 3D world position to 2D screen space (Z represents distance/depth)
            local vector, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPart.Position)
            
            if onScreen then
                -- Distance-based sizing: Scale inversely with depth (vector.Z)
                local distance = vector.Z
                local boxHeight = math.clamp(2500 / distance, 15, 800)
                local boxWidth = boxHeight * 0.6
                
                local boxX = vector.X - (boxWidth / 2)
                local boxY = vector.Y - (boxHeight / 2)
                
                -- Update main box
                visuals.Box.Size = Vector2.new(boxWidth, boxHeight)
                visuals.Box.Position = Vector2.new(boxX, boxY)
                visuals.Box.Visible = true
                
                -- Health Bar Calculations
                local healthPercent = math.clamp(humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                local currentHealthHeight = boxHeight * healthPercent
                
                -- Position health bar just to the left of the box
                local barX = boxX - 6
                local barTopY = boxY
                local barBottomY = boxY + boxHeight
                
                -- Update Health Bar Background (full height)
                visuals.HealthBarBg.From = Vector2.new(barX, barBottomY)
                visuals.HealthBarBg.To = Vector2.new(barX, barTopY)
                visuals.HealthBarBg.Visible = true
                
                -- Update Health Bar Fill (scaled by health percentage, starting from bottom)
                visuals.HealthBar.From = Vector2.new(barX, barBottomY)
                visuals.HealthBar.To = Vector2.new(barX, barBottomY - currentHealthHeight)
                -- Optional: Shift color from green to red as health drops
                visuals.HealthBar.Color = Color3.new(1 - healthPercent, healthPercent, 0)
                visuals.HealthBar.Visible = true
            else
                visuals.Box.Visible = false
                visuals.HealthBarBg.Visible = false
                visuals.HealthBar.Visible = false
            end
        else
            visuals.Box.Visible = false
            visuals.HealthBarBg.Visible = false
            visuals.HealthBar.Visible = false
        end
    end
end)

-- Toggle ESP with the F9 key
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F9 then
        ESPEnabled = not ESPEnabled
        if not ESPEnabled then
            for _, visuals in pairs(activeDrawings) do
                visuals.Box.Visible = false
                visuals.HealthBarBg.Visible = false
                visuals.HealthBar.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end
end)

scripts.title: Lemon Collector
scripts.features: auto lemon collect
scripts.script:
--By YAREK
--Switch to First person and tap Y to start/stop farm
 
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

if getgenv then
    local old = getgenv().LemonTreeScript

    if old then
        old.Running = false
        old.AutoCollecting = false

        if old.InputConnection then
            old.InputConnection:Disconnect()
        end

        if old.DescendantConnection then
            old.DescendantConnection:Disconnect()
        end

        if old.DescendantRemovingConnection then
            old.DescendantRemovingConnection:Disconnect()
        end

        if old.FlightConnection then
            old.FlightConnection:Disconnect()
        end

        if old.RescanConnection then
            old.RescanConnection:Disconnect()
        end

        if old.CameraTween then
            old.CameraTween:Cancel()
        end

        if old.FlightForce then
            old.FlightForce:Destroy()
        end

        if old.FlightAttachment then
            old.FlightAttachment:Destroy()
        end
    end

    getgenv().LemonTreeScript = {
        Running = true,
        AutoCollecting = false,
        InputConnection = nil,
        DescendantConnection = nil,
        DescendantRemovingConnection = nil,
        FlightConnection = nil,
        RescanConnection = nil,
        FlightForce = nil,
        FlightAttachment = nil,
        CameraTween = nil
    }
end

local ScriptState

if getgenv then
    ScriptState = getgenv().LemonTreeScript
else
    ScriptState = {
        Running = true,
        AutoCollecting = false
    }
end

local FIXED_Y = 3.7
local TELEPORT_OFFSET = 5
local CAMERA_TWEEN_TIME = 0.05
local FLIGHT_FORCE_MULTIPLIER = 1
local FRUIT_DELAY = 0.05
local SEARCH_DELAY = 0.03
local FRUIT_REACTION_TIME = 0.2
local CLICK_DELAY = 0.02
local VISIBILITY_ATTEMPTS = 16
local RESCAN_INTERVAL = 60

local ZONE_MIN_X = -302.91552734375
local ZONE_MAX_X = 302.94000244140625
local ZONE_MIN_Z = -457.056884765625
local ZONE_MAX_Z = 457.1495056152344

local ZONE_MARGIN = 2

local TELEPORT_MIN_X =
    ZONE_MIN_X + ZONE_MARGIN

local TELEPORT_MAX_X =
    ZONE_MAX_X - ZONE_MARGIN

local TELEPORT_MIN_Z =
    ZONE_MIN_Z + ZONE_MARGIN

local TELEPORT_MAX_Z =
    ZONE_MAX_Z - ZONE_MARGIN

local trees = {}
local fruitCache = {}
local fruitStates = {}
local previousFruitPresence = {}
local lastRescan = 0

local VirtualInputManager

pcall(function()
    VirtualInputManager =
        game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
end)

local function isRunning()
    return ScriptState.Running == true
end

local function getVisualFruit(clickPart)
    if not clickPart then
        return nil
    end

    local fruit = clickPart.Parent

    if not fruit then
        return nil
    end

    if fruit.Name ~= "Fruit" then
        return nil
    end

    if not fruit:IsA("BasePart") then
        return nil
    end

    return fruit
end

local function isClickFruitPart(object)
    if not object then
        return false
    end

    if object.Name ~= "ClickFruitPart" then
        return false
    end

    if not object:IsA("BasePart") then
        return false
    end

    local fruit = object.Parent

    if not fruit then
        return false
    end

    if fruit.Name ~= "Fruit" then
        return false
    end

    if not fruit:IsA("BasePart") then
        return false
    end

    local detector =
        object:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")

    if not detector then
        return false
    end

    return true
end

local function addTree(tree)
    if not isRunning() then
        return
    end

    if not tree then
        return
    end

    if tree.Name ~= "LemonTree" then
        return
    end

    if not tree:IsA("Model") then
        return
    end

    if not table.find(trees, tree) then
        trees[#trees + 1] = tree
    end
end

local function addFruitToCache(object)
    if not isRunning() then
        return
    end

    if not isClickFruitPart(object) then
        return
    end

    local fruit = object.Parent

    if not fruit then
        return
    end

    local lemonTree =
        fruit:FindFirstAncestor("LemonTree")

    if not lemonTree then
        return
    end

    if not lemonTree:IsA("Model") then
        return
    end

    if not lemonTree:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        return
    end

    fruitCache[object] = true
end

local function removeFruitFromCache(object)
    if object then
        fruitCache[object] = nil
    end
end

local function scanContainer(container)
    if not isRunning() then
        return
    end

    if not container then
        return
    end

    if container.Name == "LemonTree"
        and container:IsA("Model") then

        addTree(container)

        for _, object in ipairs(
            container:GetDescendants()
        ) do

            if not isRunning() then
                return
            end

            if isClickFruitPart(object) then
                addFruitToCache(object)
            end
        end

        return
    end

    for _, child in ipairs(
        container:GetChildren()
    ) do

        if not isRunning() then
            return
        end

        if child.Name == "LemonTree"
            and child:IsA("Model") then

            scanContainer(child)

        elseif child:IsA("Folder")
            or child:IsA("Model") then

            scanContainer(child)
        end
    end
end

local function rebuildTreeList()
    if not isRunning() then
        return
    end

    local newTrees = {}
    local newTreeSet = {}

    for i = 1, 9 do
        if not isRunning() then
            return
        end

        local tycoon =
            workspace:FindFirstChild(
                "Tycoon" .. i
            )

        if tycoon then
            for _, object in ipairs(
                tycoon:GetDescendants()
            ) do

                if object.Name == "LemonTree"
                    and object:IsA("Model") then

                    if not newTreeSet[object] then
                        newTreeSet[object] = true
                        newTrees[#newTrees + 1] =
                            object
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local directTree =
        workspace:FindFirstChild(
            "LemonTree"
        )

    if directTree
        and directTree:IsA("Model") then

        if not newTreeSet[directTree] then
            newTreeSet[directTree] = true
            newTrees[#newTrees + 1] =
                directTree
        end
    end

    trees = newTrees
end

local function rebuildFruitCache()
    if not isRunning() then
        return
    end

    local oldPresence =
        previousFruitPresence

    local newCache = {}
    local newPresence = {}

    for _, tree in ipairs(trees) do

        if tree
            and tree.Parent
            and tree:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then

            for _, object in ipairs(
                tree:GetDescendants()
            ) do

                if not isRunning() then
                    return
                end

                if isClickFruitPart(object) then

                    newCache[object] = true
                    newPresence[object] = true

                    if not oldPresence[object] then
                        fruitStates[object] = nil
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for fruit in pairs(fruitStates) do
        if not newPresence[fruit] then
            fruitStates[fruit] = nil
        end
    end

    fruitCache = newCache
    previousFruitPresence = newPresence
end

local function fullRescan()
    if not isRunning() then
        return
    end

    rebuildTreeList()
    rebuildFruitCache()

    lastRescan = os.clock()
end

fullRescan()

ScriptState.DescendantConnection =
    workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(
        function(object)

            if not isRunning() then
                return
            end

            if object.Name == "LemonTree"
                and object:IsA("Model") then

                addTree(object)

                for _, child in ipairs(
                    object:GetDescendants()
                ) do

                    if isClickFruitPart(child) then
                        addFruitToCache(child)
                    end
                end

                return
            end

            if isClickFruitPart(object) then
                addFruitToCache(object)
            end
        end
    )

ScriptState.DescendantRemovingConnection =
    workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(
        function(object)

            removeFruitFromCache(object)

        end
    )

ScriptState.RescanConnection =
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(
        function()

            if not isRunning() then
                return
            end

            if not ScriptState.AutoCollecting then
                return
            end

            if os.clock() - lastRescan
                >= RESCAN_INTERVAL then

                fullRescan()

            end
        end
    )

local function isFruitValid(clickPart)

    if not clickPart then
        return false
    end

    if not clickPart.Parent then
        return false
    end

    if not clickPart:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        return false
    end

    local detector =
        clickPart:FindFirstChildOfClass(
            "ClickDetector"
        )

    if not detector then
        return false
    end

    local fruit =
        getVisualFruit(clickPart)

    if not fruit then
        return false
    end

    if not fruit:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        return false
    end

    return true
end

local function isFruitActuallyVisible(clickPart)

    if not isFruitValid(clickPart) then
        return false
    end

    local fruit =
        getVisualFruit(clickPart)

    if not fruit then
        return false
    end

    if fruit.Transparency >= 0.95 then
        return false
    end

    if fruit.Size.Magnitude < 0.05 then
        return false
    end

    return true
end

local function isPositionInsideZone(position)

    return
        position.X >= TELEPORT_MIN_X
        and
        position.X <= TELEPORT_MAX_X
        and
        position.Z >= TELEPORT_MIN_Z
        and
        position.Z <= TELEPORT_MAX_Z
end

local function getCandidatePosition(
    fruit,
    angle
)

    local radians =
        math.rad(angle)

    local direction =
        Vector3.new(
            math.cos(radians),
            0,
            math.sin(radians)
        )

    local position =
        fruit.Position
        + direction * TELEPORT_OFFSET

    return Vector3.new(
        position.X,
        FIXED_Y,
        position.Z
    )
end

local function canReachFruit(fruit)

    if not isFruitValid(fruit) then
        return false
    end

    for attempt = 0,
        VISIBILITY_ATTEMPTS - 1
    do

        local angle =
            attempt
            * (
                360
                / VISIBILITY_ATTEMPTS
            )

        local candidate =
            getCandidatePosition(
                fruit,
                angle
            )

        if isPositionInsideZone(candidate) then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function getFruitState(fruit)

    local state =
        fruitStates[fruit]

    if not state then
        return nil
    end

    if state.Position then

        local distance =
            (
                fruit.Position
                - state.Position
            ).Magnitude

        if distance > 1 then
            fruitStates[fruit] = nil
            return nil
        end
    end

    return state
end

local function skipFruit(fruit)

    if not fruit then
        return
    end

    fruitStates[fruit] = {
        Skipped = true,
        Position = fruit.Position
    }
end

local function canUseFruit(fruit)

    if not isFruitValid(fruit) then
        return false
    end

    local state =
        getFruitState(fruit)

    if state
        and state.Skipped then

        return false
    end

    if not isFruitActuallyVisible(fruit) then

        skipFruit(fruit)

        return false
    end

    if not canReachFruit(fruit) then

        skipFruit(fruit)

        return false
    end

    return true
end

local function getNearestFruit()

    if not isRunning() then
        return nil
    end

    local character =
        player.Character

    if not character then
        return nil
    end

    local root =
        character:FindFirstChild(
            "HumanoidRootPart"
        )

    if not root then
        return nil
    end

    local nearest = nil
    local nearestDistance = math.huge

    for fruit in pairs(fruitCache) do

        if not isFruitValid(fruit) then

            fruitCache[fruit] = nil

        elseif canUseFruit(fruit) then

            local visualFruit =
                getVisualFruit(fruit)

            if visualFruit then

                local distance =
                    (
                        root.Position
                        - visualFruit.Position
                    ).Magnitude

                if distance <
                    nearestDistance then

                    nearestDistance =
                        distance

                    nearest =
                        fruit
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

local function findBestPosition(fruit)

    if not isFruitValid(fruit) then
        return nil
    end

    local character =
        player.Character

    if not character then
        return nil
    end

    local root =
        character:FindFirstChild(
            "HumanoidRootPart"
        )

    if not root then
        return nil
    end

    local offset =
        root.Position
        - fruit.Position

    local horizontal =
        Vector3.new(
            offset.X,
            0,
            offset.Z
        )

    local startAngle = 0

    if horizontal.Magnitude > 0.1 then

        startAngle =
            math.deg(
                math.atan2(
                    horizontal.Z,
                    horizontal.X
                )
            )
    end

    for attempt = 0,
        VISIBILITY_ATTEMPTS - 1
    do

        local angle =
            startAngle
            + (
                attempt
                * (
                    360
                    / VISIBILITY_ATTEMPTS
                )
            )

        local candidate =
            getCandidatePosition(
                fruit,
                angle
            )

        if isPositionInsideZone(candidate) then
            return candidate
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function teleportToFruit(fruit)

    if not isRunning() then
        return false
    end

    if not isFruitValid(fruit) then
        return false
    end

    local targetPosition =
        findBestPosition(fruit)

    if not targetPosition then

        skipFruit(fruit)

        return false
    end

    local character =
        player.Character

    if not character then
        return false
    end

    local root =
        character:FindFirstChild(
            "HumanoidRootPart"
        )

    if not root then
        return false
    end

    root.CFrame =
        CFrame.new(
            targetPosition
        )

    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

    if not isFruitActuallyVisible(fruit) then

        skipFruit(fruit)

        return false
    end

    return true
end

local function turnCameraToFruit(fruit)

    if not isRunning() then
        return false
    end

    if not isFruitValid(fruit) then
        return false
    end

    local camera =
        workspace.CurrentCamera

    if not camera then
        return false
    end

    local visualFruit =
        getVisualFruit(fruit)

    if not visualFruit then
        return false
    end

    if ScriptState.CameraTween then

        ScriptState.CameraTween:Cancel()
        ScriptState.CameraTween = nil

    end

    local cameraPosition =
        camera.CFrame.Position

    local direction =
        visualFruit.Position
        - cameraPosition

    if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then
        return false
    end

    direction =
        direction.Unit

    local targetCFrame =
        CFrame.lookAt(
            cameraPosition,
            cameraPosition
                + direction,
            Vector3.yAxis
        )

    local tween =
        TweenService:Create(
            camera,
            TweenInfo.new(
                CAMERA_TWEEN_TIME,
                Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,
                Enum.EasingDirection.Out
            ),
            {
                CFrame = targetCFrame
            }
        )

    ScriptState.CameraTween =
        tween

    tween.Completed:Connect(
        function()

            if ScriptState.CameraTween ==
                tween then

                if isFruitValid(fruit) then

                    local currentCamera =
                        workspace.CurrentCamera

                    local currentFruit =
                        getVisualFruit(fruit)

                    if currentCamera
                        and currentFruit then

                        local position =
                            currentCamera.CFrame.Position

                        local finalDirection =
                            currentFruit.Position
                            - position

                        if finalDirection.Magnitude
                            > 0.01 then

                            currentCamera.CFrame =
                                CFrame.lookAt(
                                    position,
                                    position
                                        + finalDirection.Unit,
                                    Vector3.yAxis
                                )
                        end
                    end
                end

                ScriptState.CameraTween =
                    nil
            end
        end
    )

    tween:Play()

    return true
end

local function isCameraLookingAtFruit(fruit)

    if not isFruitActuallyVisible(fruit) then
        return false
    end

    local camera =
        workspace.CurrentCamera

    if not camera then
        return false
    end

    local visualFruit =
        getVisualFruit(fruit)

    if not visualFruit then
        return false
    end

    local params =
        RaycastParams.new()

    params.FilterType =
        Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    params.IgnoreWater = true

    local filter = {}

    if player.Character then
        filter[#filter + 1] =
            player.Character
    end

    params.FilterDescendantsInstances =
        filter

    local origin =
        camera.CFrame.Position

    local direction =
        visualFruit.Position
        - origin

    if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then
        return true
    end

    local result =
        workspace:Raycast(
            origin,
            direction,
            params
        )

    if not result then
        return true
    end

    if result.Instance ==
        visualFruit then

        return true
    end

    if result.Instance ==
        fruit then

        return true
    end

    return false
end

local function simulateMouseClick(fruit)

    if not isRunning() then
        return false
    end

    if not isFruitValid(fruit) then
        return false
    end

    local camera =
        workspace.CurrentCamera

    if not camera then
        return false
    end

    local visualFruit =
        getVisualFruit(fruit)

    if not visualFruit then
        return false
    end

    local screenPosition,
        onScreen =
        camera:WorldToScreenPoint(
            visualFruit.Position
        )

    if not onScreen then
        return false
    end

    local x =
        math.floor(
            screenPosition.X
        )

    local y =
        math.floor(
            screenPosition.Y
        )

    if x < 0
        or y < 0
        or x > camera.ViewportSize.X
        or y > camera.ViewportSize.Y then

        return false
    end

    if VirtualInputManager then

        local moveOk =
            pcall(
                function()

                    VirtualInputManager:
                        SendMouseMoveEvent(
                            x,
                            y,
                            game
                        )

                end
            )

        if not moveOk then
            return false
        end

        task.wait(CLICK_DELAY)

        local downOk =
            pcall(
                function()

                    VirtualInputManager:
                        SendMouseButtonEvent(
                            x,
                            y,
                            0,
                            true,
                            game,
                            0
                        )

                end
            )

        if not downOk then
            return false
        end

        task.wait(CLICK_DELAY)

        local upOk =
            pcall(
                function()

                    VirtualInputManager:
                        SendMouseButtonEvent(
                            x,
                            y,
                            0,
                            false,
                            game,
                            0
                        )

                end
            )

        if not upOk then
            return false
        end

        return true
    end

    if mouse1click then

        local ok =
            pcall(
                function()
                    mouse1click()
                end
            )

        if ok then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function waitForFruitReaction(fruit)

    local startTime =
        os.clock()

    local initialPosition =
        fruit.Position

    while
        isRunning()
        and
        ScriptState.AutoCollecting
        and
        os.clock() - startTime
            < FRUIT_REACTION_TIME
    do

        if not isFruitValid(fruit) then
            return true
        end

        if not isFruitActuallyVisible(fruit) then
            return true
        end

        if (
            fruit.Position
            - initialPosition
        ).Magnitude > 0.05 then

            return true
        end

        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    end

    return false
end

local function processFruit(fruit)

    if not isRunning() then
        return false
    end

    if not ScriptState.AutoCollecting then
        return false
    end

    if not isFruitValid(fruit) then
        return false
    end

    local state =
        getFruitState(fruit)

    if state
        and state.Skipped then

        return false
    end

    fruitStates[fruit] = {
        Skipped = true,
        Position = fruit.Position
    }

    if not teleportToFruit(fruit) then
        return false
    end

    RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()

    if not turnCameraToFruit(fruit) then
        return false
    end

    task.wait(
        CAMERA_TWEEN_TIME
    )

    if not isCameraLookingAtFruit(fruit) then
        return false
    end

    task.wait(FRUIT_DELAY)

    if not simulateMouseClick(fruit) then
        return false
    end

    return waitForFruitReaction(fruit)
end

local function enableFlight()

    if not isRunning() then
        return
    end

    local character =
        player.Character

    if not character then
        return
    end

    local root =
        character:FindFirstChild(
            "HumanoidRootPart"
        )

    if not root then
        return
    end

    if ScriptState.FlightForce then
        ScriptState.FlightForce:Destroy()
        ScriptState.FlightForce = nil
    end

    if ScriptState.FlightAttachment then
        ScriptState.FlightAttachment:Destroy()
        ScriptState.FlightAttachment = nil
    end

    local attachment =
        Instance.new(
            "Attachment"
        )

    attachment.Name =
        "LemonFlightAttachment"

    attachment.Parent =
        root

    ScriptState.FlightAttachment =
        attachment

    local force =
        Instance.new(
            "VectorForce"
        )

    force.Name =
        "LemonFlightForce"

    force.Attachment0 =
        attachment

    force.RelativeTo =
        Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World

    force.ApplyAtCenterOfMass =
        true

    force.Force =
        Vector3.new(
            0,
            root.AssemblyMass
                * workspace.Gravity
                * FLIGHT_FORCE_MULTIPLIER,
            0
        )

    force.Parent =
        root

    ScriptState.FlightForce =
        force
end

local function disableFlight()

    if ScriptState.FlightForce then
        ScriptState.FlightForce:Destroy()
        ScriptState.FlightForce = nil
    end

    if ScriptState.FlightAttachment then
        ScriptState.FlightAttachment:Destroy()
        ScriptState.FlightAttachment = nil
    end
end

ScriptState.FlightConnection =
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(
        function()

            if not isRunning() then
                return
            end

            local character =
                player.Character

            if not character then
                return
            end

            local root =
                character:FindFirstChild(
                    "HumanoidRootPart"
                )

            if not root then
                return
            end

            if ScriptState.FlightForce then

                ScriptState.FlightForce.Force =
                    Vector3.new(
                        0,
                        root.AssemblyMass
                            * workspace.Gravity
                            * FLIGHT_FORCE_MULTIPLIER,
                        0
                    )
            end
        end
    )

local function autoCollectLoop()

    enableFlight()

    while
        isRunning()
        and
        ScriptState.AutoCollecting
    do

        local ok =
            pcall(
                function()

                    if os.clock() - lastRescan
                        >= RESCAN_INTERVAL then

                        fullRescan()

                    end

                    local fruit =
                        getNearestFruit()

                    if not fruit then

                        fullRescan()

                        fruit =
                            getNearestFruit()

                    end

                    if fruit then
                        processFruit(fruit)
                    end
                end
            )

        task.wait(SEARCH_DELAY)
    end
end

ScriptState.InputConnection =
    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(
        function(
            input,
            gameProcessed
        )

            if not isRunning() then
                return
            end

            if gameProcessed then
                return
            end

            if input.KeyCode
                ~= Enum.KeyCode.Y then

                return
            end

            if ScriptState.AutoCollecting then

                ScriptState.AutoCollecting =
                    false

                if ScriptState.CameraTween then
                    ScriptState.CameraTween:Cancel()
                    ScriptState.CameraTween = nil
                end

                disableFlight()

                return
            end

            ScriptState.AutoCollecting =
                true

            lastRescan = 0

            task.spawn(
                autoCollectLoop
            )
        end
    )

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(
    function()

        if not isRunning() then
            return
        end

        fruitStates = {}
        previousFruitPresence = {}

        task.wait(1)

        fullRescan()

        if ScriptState.AutoCollecting then
            enableFlight()
        end
    end
)

    local tc=target and target.Character; if not tc then return end
    local hum=tc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid"); if not hum then return end
    local head=tc:FindFirstChild(hpart or "Head") or tc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not head then return end
    if not damage or damage==math.huge then
        local sd; pcall(function() local st=tool:FindFirstChild("Setting"); if st then local s=require(st); if s then sd=tonumber(s.Damage) or tonumber(s.BaseDamage) end end end)
        damage = sd or 200
    end
    local handle=tool:FindFirstChild("Handle"); if not handle then return end
    local gsl=tool:FindFirstChild("GunScript_Local")
    local gss=tool:FindFirstChild("GunScript_Server")
    local fp=handle:FindFirstChild("GunFirePoint") or handle
    local origin=fp.Position
    local dir=(head.Position-origin); dir=dir.Magnitude>0 and dir.Unit or Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
    local infOrigin=head.Position - dir*3
    local ig=gss and gss:FindFirstChild("IgniteScript")
    local ic=gss and gss:FindFirstChild("IcifyScript")
    pcall(function()
        local setting=tool:FindFirstChild("Setting")
        if setting then local s=require(setting); if s then s.LimitedAmmoEnabled=false; s.Ammo=10000; s.AmmoPerMag=10000; s.MagCount=10000; s.StoredAmmo=10000; s.MaxAmmo=10000 end end
    end)
    pcall(function() ReplicatedStorage.VisualizeMuzzle:FireServer(handle,true,{false,7,Color3.new(1,1.1098,0),15,true,0.02}, gsl and gsl:FindFirstChild("MuzzleEffect")) end)
    pcall(function() ReplicatedStorage.VisualizeBullet:FireServer(
        tool, handle, dir, fp,
        {true,{112139677907598,92977228204408,112139677907598,92977228204408},1,1,3.5, gsl and gsl:FindFirstChild("HitEffect"), true},
        {true,{0,0,0,0,0,0},1,1,1, gsl and gsl:FindFirstChild("BloodEffect")},
        {true,0.2,{3696144972},true,7,1},
        {false,8,true,{163064102},1,1.5,1,false, gsl and gsl:FindFirstChild("ExplosionEffect")},
        {false,Vector3.new(0.1,0,0),Vector3.new(-0.1,0,0), gsl and gsl:FindFirstChild("TracerEffect"), nil, gsl and gsl:FindFirstChild("ParticleEffect"),300,500,0,Vector3.zero,Vector3.new(0.4,0.4,0.4),Color3.new(0.639,0.635,0.611),1,Enum.Material.Neon,Enum.PartType.Cylinder,false,6696543809,0,Vector3.new(0.007,0.007,0.007)},
        {true,{269514869,269514887,269514807,269514817},0.5,1,1.5,100},
        {false,3,Color3.new(1,0.647,0.6),6,true}
    ) end)
    pcall(function() ReplicatedStorage.InflictTarget:FireServer(
        tool, LocalPlayer, hum, head, damage,
        {0,0,false,false,ig,ic,100,100},
        {false,5,3}, head,
        {false,{1930359546},1,1.5,1},
        infOrigin, dir
    ) end)
end

function wsSlimeKill(p)
    if not p or not p.Character then return end
    local th = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not th or not hrp then return end
    checkgun()
    local original = hrp.CFrame
    pcall(function() hrp.CFrame = th.CFrame end)
    pcall(function() hrp.Anchored = true end)
    task.wait(0.07)
    pcall(function() KillGunMod(p, "Head", math.huge) end)
    task.wait(0.07)
    pcall(function() KillGunMod(p, "Head", math.huge) end)
    task.wait(0.18)
    pcall(function() KillGunMod(p, "Head", math.huge) end)
    task.wait(0.1)
    pcall(function() hrp.Anchored = false end)
    local h2 = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if h2 and original then pcall(function() h2.CFrame = original end) end
end

function checkgun()
    local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    local gunTool = nil
    for _, v in pairs(player.Backpack:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("LocalScript") and v.Name == "GunScript_Local" then
            gunTool = v.Parent
            break
        end
    end
    if not gunTool and player.Character then
        for _, v in pairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("LocalScript") and v.Name == "GunScript_Local" then
                gunTool = v.Parent
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if gunTool and gunTool:IsA("Tool") then
        player.Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid"):EquipTool(gunTool)
    end
    return gunTool
end

local function fireproximityprompt(prompt)
    if not (prompt and prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt")) then return end

    if _nativeFPP then
        if pcall(_nativeFPP, prompt, 1) then return end
        if pcall(_nativeFPP, prompt) then return end
    end

    pcall(function()
        local oldHold, oldDist, oldLoS = prompt.HoldDuration, prompt.MaxActivationDistance, prompt.RequiresLineOfSight
        prompt.HoldDuration = 0
        prompt.MaxActivationDistance = math.max(oldDist, 1000)
        prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
        prompt:InputHoldBegin()
        task.wait()
        prompt:InputHoldEnd()
        prompt.MaxActivationDistance = oldDist
        prompt.HoldDuration = oldHold
        prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = oldLoS
    end)
end

local function getcp()
    local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
    local closest, dist = nil, math.huge
    for _, v in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if v ~= LocalPlayer and v.Character and v.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
            local pos, onScreen = workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToScreenPoint(v.Character.Head.Position)
            if onScreen then
                local d = (Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) - Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y)).Magnitude
                if d < dist then dist = d; closest = v end
            end
        end
    end
    return closest
end

local function MarketHasItem(toolName)
    local market = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("MarketItems")
    if not market then return false end
    for _, item in ipairs(market:GetChildren()) do
        if item.Name == toolName and item:FindFirstChild("owner") and item.owner.Value == LocalPlayer.Name then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function ForcePutToMarket(toolName)
    local endTime = os.clock() + 12
    while os.clock() < endTime do
        if MarketHasItem(toolName) then return true end
        pcall(function() ReplicatedStorage.ListWeaponRemote:FireServer(toolName, 999999) end)
        task.wait(0.15)
    end
    return false
end
local function ForceRetrieveFromMarket(toolName)
    local market = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MarketItems", 10)
    if not market then return false end
    local endTime = os.clock() + 12
    while os.clock() < endTime do
        for _, item in ipairs(market:GetChildren()) do
            if item.Name == toolName and item:FindFirstChild("owner") and item.owner.Value == LocalPlayer.Name and item:GetAttribute("SpecialId") then
                local special = item:GetAttribute("SpecialId")
                pcall(function() ReplicatedStorage.BuyItemRemote:FireServer(toolName, "Remove", special) end)
                task.wait(0.2)
                pcall(function() ReplicatedStorage.BackpackRemote:InvokeServer("Grab", toolName) end)
                task.wait(0.2)
                if BackpackHasItem(toolName) then return true end
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.3)
    end
    return false
end

    local function sel(it) return it.type ~= "section" and it.type ~= "label" end

    local function buildRow(i, it)
        local y = (i - 1) * ROWH
        local btn = create("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, y), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, ROWH), Parent = list })
        local hl = create("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.Hi, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0), Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = btn })
        local accent = create("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(0,3,1,0), Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0), BackgroundColor3 = T.Accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = btn })

        if it.type == "section" then
            create("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = it.text, Font = T.FontBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = T.Spark,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0), Parent = btn })
            return { setSel = function() end }
        end

        local lx, iconObj = 14, nil
        if it.icon then
            iconObj = create("ImageLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = "rbxassetid://" .. it.icon, ImageColor3 = T.Sub, Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, -8), Parent = btn })
            lx = 38
        end
        local label = create("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = (it.type == "back" and "‹  Back") or it.text,
            Font = T.FontMed, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = T.Text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            Position = UDim2.new(0, lx, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -lx - 150, 1, 0), Parent = btn })

        local glyphs = {}
        local function addGlyph(text, xr, w, col, align, keep)
            local t = create("TextLabel", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = text, Font = T.FontBold, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = col,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                TextXAlignment = align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Position = UDim2.new(1, xr, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 1, 0), Parent = btn })
            glyphs[#glyphs+1] = { obj = t, normal = col, keep = keep } return t
        end

        if it.type == "submenu" or it.type == "dropopt" then addGlyph(">", -22, 14, T.Sub)
        elseif it.type == "toggle" then addGlyph(it.state and "ON" or "OFF", -52, 44, it.state and T.On or T.Off, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, true)
        elseif it.type == "dropdown" then
            addGlyph(tostring(it.options[it.idx] or "-"), -150, 130, T.Spark, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, true)
            addGlyph(">", -16, 12, T.Sub)
        elseif it.type == "slider" then
            create("TextButton", { Text = "‹", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = T.FontBold, TextSize = 16, TextColor3 = T.Sub,
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -86, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 1, 0), Parent = btn }).MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ctrl.index = i ctrl:updateHL() ctrl:adjust(-1) end)
            it._vlab = addGlyph(tostring(it.value), -68, 50, T.Spark)
            create("TextButton", { Text = "›", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = T.FontBold, TextSize = 16, TextColor3 = T.Sub,
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 1, 0), Parent = btn }).MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ctrl.index = i ctrl:updateHL() ctrl:adjust(1) end)
        elseif it.type == "textbox" then
            local boxf = create("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = T.Element, BackgroundTransparency = 0.2, Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 22), Position = UDim2.new(1, -98, 0.5, -11), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = btn })
            local tb = create("TextBox", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = it.value or "", PlaceholderText = it.placeholder or "...", PlaceholderColor3 = T.Sub,
                Font = T.Font, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = T.Text, Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 0), ClearTextOnFocus = false, Parent = boxf })
            tb.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) it.value = tb.Text safe(it.cb, tb.Text, enter) end)
        elseif it.type == "keybind" then
            addGlyph((ctrl.listening == it) and "..." or (it.key and it.key.Name or "None"), -14, 72, T.Spark, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, true)
        end

        local function setSel(s)
            hl.BackgroundTransparency = s and 0 or 1
            accent.BackgroundTransparency = s and 0 or 1
            label.TextColor3 = s and T.Dark or T.Text
            if iconObj then iconObj.ImageColor3 = s and T.Dark or T.Sub end
            for _, g in ipairs(glyphs) do if not g.keep then g.obj.TextColor3 = s and T.Dark or g.normal end end
        end
        setSel(false)
        if sel(it) then
            btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() ctrl.index = i ctrl:updateHL() ctrl:updateFooter() end)
            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ctrl.index = i ctrl:updateHL() ctrl:activate() end)
        end
        return { setSel = setSel }
    end

    function ctrl:render()
        for _, c in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("GuiButton") then c:Destroy() end end
        secLabel.Text = self.current.Name
        crumb.Text = self.current.Parent and "‹ esc" or ""
        local rows = {}
        if self.current.Parent then rows[#rows+1] = { type = "back" } end
        for _, it in ipairs(self.current.Items) do rows[#rows+1] = it end
        self.rows = rows
        if self.index > #rows then self.index = #rows end
        if self.index < 1 then self.index = 1 end
        if rows[self.index] and not sel(rows[self.index]) then for j = 1, #rows do if sel(rows[j]) then self.index = j break end end end
        self.rowObjs = {}
        for i, it in ipairs(rows) do self.rowObjs[i] = buildRow(i, it) end
        list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, #rows * ROWH)
        list.ScrollBarThickness = (#rows > LIST_ROWS) and 4 or 0
        self:updateHL() self:updateFooter() self:scrollIntoView()
    end
    function ctrl:updateHL() for i, o in ipairs(self.rowObjs) do o.setSel(i == self.index) end end
    function ctrl:updateFooter() idxLbl.Text = string.format("%d / %d", self.index, #self.rows) end
    function ctrl:scrollIntoView()
        local top = (self.index - 1) * ROWH
        local cp = list.CanvasPosition.Y
        if top < cp then cp = top elseif top + ROWH > cp + LIST_H then cp = top + ROWH - LIST_H end
        list.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(cp, 0))
    end
    function ctrl:move(d)
        local n = #self.rows if n == 0 then return end
        local i = self.index
        for _ = 1, n do i = ((i - 1 + d) % n) + 1 if sel(self.rows[i]) then break end end
        self.index = i self:updateHL() self:updateFooter() self:scrollIntoView()
    end
    function ctrl:open(p) p.Parent = p.Parent or self.current self.current = p self.index = 1 self:render() end
    function ctrl:back() if self.current.Parent then self.current = self.current.Parent self.index = 1 self:render() end end
    function ctrl:activate()
        local it = self.rows[self.index] if not it then return end
        if it.type == "back" then self:back()
        elseif it.type == "submenu" then self:open(it.target)
        elseif it.type == "button" then safe(it.cb)
        elseif it.type == "toggle" then it.state = not it.state safe(it.cb, it.state) self:render()
        elseif it.type == "slider" then self:adjust(1)
        elseif it.type == "dropdown" then
            local pg = { Name = it.text:upper(), Parent = self.current, Items = {} }
            for vi, opt in ipairs(it.options) do pg.Items[#pg.Items+1] = { type = "dropopt", text = tostring(opt), _drop = it, _vi = vi } end
            self:open(pg)
        elseif it.type == "dropopt" then it._drop.idx = it._vi safe(it._drop.cb, it._drop.options[it._vi]) self:back()
        elseif it.type == "keybind" then if self.listening == it then self.listening = nil else self.listening = it end self:render()
        end
    end
    function ctrl:adjust(d)
        local it = self.rows[self.index] if not it then return end
        if it.type == "slider" then
            it.value = math.clamp(it.value + d * it.step, it.min, it.max)
            if it._vlab then it._vlab.Text = tostring(it.value) end
            safe(it.cb, it.value)
        elseif it.type == "submenu" and d > 0 then self:open(it.target) end
    end

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
        if gpe or not win.Visible then return end
        if ctrl.listening then
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                local kb = ctrl.listening ; ctrl.listening = nil
                kb.key = input.KeyCode ; safe(kb.cb, input.KeyCode) ; ctrl:render()
            end
            return
        end
        local k = input.KeyCode
        if k == Enum.KeyCode.Up then ctrl:move(-1)
        elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Down then ctrl:move(1)
        elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.KeypadEnter then ctrl:activate()
        elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Right then ctrl:adjust(1)
        elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Left then ctrl:adjust(-1)
        elseif k == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then ctrl:back() end
    end)

    local allItems = {}
    local function add(page, item) table.insert(page.Items, item) table.insert(allItems, item) if ctrl.current == page then ctrl:render() end return item end

    local function dummy() return setmetatable({}, { __index = function() return "" end, __newindex = function() end }) end
    UI = {}

    function UI:Fire(label)
        for _, it in ipairs(allItems) do
            if it.text == label then
                if it.type == "toggle" then it.state = not it.state safe(it.cb, it.state) ctrl:render() return it.state
                elseif it.type == "button" then safe(it.cb) return true end
            end
        end
    end
    function UI:AddTab(name, icon, order)
        local page = { Name = tostring(name):upper(), Items = {}, Parent = root }
        table.insert(root.Items, { type = "submenu", text = tostring(name), target = page, icon = Logos[2], order = order or 999 })
        table.sort(root.Items, function(a, b) return (a.order or 999) < (b.order or 999) end)
        if ctrl.current == root then ctrl:render() end
        return page
    end
    function UI:AddSection(parent, text) add(parent, { type = "section", text = tostring(text) }) return dummy() end
    function UI:AddButton(parent, text, cb) add(parent, { type = "button", text = tostring(text), cb = cb }) return dummy() end
    function UI:AddToggle(parent, text, default, cb) add(parent, { type = "toggle", text = tostring(text), state = default and true or false, cb = cb }) return dummy() end
    function UI:AddSlider(parent, text, min, max, default, cb)
        local step = math.max(1, math.floor((max - min) / 20 + 0.5))
        add(parent, { type = "slider", text = tostring(text), min = min, max = max, value = math.clamp(default or min, min, max), step = step, cb = cb })
        return dummy()
    end
    function UI:AddDropdown(parent, text, options, default, cb)
        local idx = 1
        for i, o in ipairs(options) do if o == default then idx = i end end
        local item = add(parent, { type = "dropdown", text = tostring(text), options = options, idx = idx, cb = cb })
        local function update(newOpts) item.options = newOpts or {} if item.idx > #item.options then item.idx = math.max(1, #item.options) end if ctrl.current == parent then ctrl:render() end end
        return dummy(), update
    end
    function UI:AddTextBox(parent, text, placeholder, cb)
        local item = add(parent, { type = "textbox", text = tostring(text), placeholder = placeholder, value = "", cb = cb })
        return dummy(), function() return item.value end
    end
    function UI:AddKeybind(parent, text, default, cb)
        add(parent, { type = "keybind", text = tostring(text), key = default, cb = cb })
        return dummy()
    end

    ctrl:render()
end

function ApplySkin(tool, imageId)
    if not tool then return end
    for _, obj in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("MeshPart") then
            -- mesh gun bodies are skinned via TextureID (decals don't show on meshes)
            pcall(function() obj.TextureID = imageId end)
            pcall(function() obj.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) end)
        elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
                if child.Name == "ScorpioSkin" then child:Destroy() end
            end
            for _, face in ipairs(Enum.NormalId:GetEnumItems()) do
                local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
                decal.Name = "ScorpioSkin"
                decal.Texture = imageId
                decal.Face = face
                decal.Parent = obj
            end
        end
        if obj:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
            -- legacy meshes inside Parts
            pcall(function() obj.TextureId = imageId end)
        end
    end
end

local function CleanupCarFly()
    if bv then bv:Destroy(); bv = nil end
    if bg then bg:Destroy(); bg = nil end
end
local function SetupCarFly()
    CleanupCarFly()
    if not Config.TheBronx.carfly then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character; if not char then return end
    hum = char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid"); if not hum then return end
    seat = hum.SeatPart; if not seat or not seat:IsA("VehicleSeat") then return end
    car = seat.Parent; if not car then return end
    root = car.PrimaryPart; if not root then return end
    lastCar = car
    for _, v in ipairs(car:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA("BasePart") and not v.Name:lower():find("wheel") then v.CanCollide = false end end
    bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity"); bv.MaxForce=Vector3.new(1e9,1e9,1e9); bv.Velocity=Vector3.zero; bv.Parent=root
    bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro"); bg.MaxTorque=Vector3.new(1e9,1e9,1e9); bg.P=25000; bg.D=1500; bg.CFrame=root.CFrame; bg.Parent=root
end
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.2)
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char then
        local h = char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
        if h then
        local currentSeat = h.SeatPart
        if currentSeat and currentSeat:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
            if currentSeat.Parent ~= lastCar then SetupCarFly() end
        else
            if lastCar then CleanupCarFly(); lastCar = nil end
        end
        end
        end
    end
end)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not Config.TheBronx.carfly then CleanupCarFly(); return end
    if not hum or hum.SeatPart ~= seat then return end
    if not root or not bv or not bg then SetupCarFly(); return end
    local carSpeed = Config.TheBronx.carflyspeed or 120
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera; local camCF = cam.CFrame
    local camLook = camCF.LookVector; local camRight = camCF.RightVector
    if not UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
        if UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + camLook) end
        local move = Vector3.zero
